name: Imperial Guard
description: The Imperial Guard are hand-selected from the finest Army and Marine veterans. Guardsmen serve at the Imperial Palace on Capital and are deployed throughout the Imperium on critical missions. Membership is the highest honour in the Imperial military. Those who serve two or more terms earn SOC+2, a doubled equipment budget, DM+1 on benefit rolls, and may claim automatic TAS Membership.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: You serve the Emperor directly — rotating between ceremonial Palace duties, security deployments, and classified missions throughout the Imperium.

mishaps.1: Wounded shielding a dignitary from an attack. Roll on the Injury table. Lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.2: Court intrigue places the blame for a security failure on you. Lose SOC -1.
mishaps.3: A politically sensitive reassignment removes you from your post. You may remain in service. Lose one rank.
mishaps.4: A security breach occurs on your watch. An official inquiry follows. Lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: A classified off-world deployment ends badly. Gain an Enemy and lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.6: A scandal — real or fabricated — triggers a discharge investigation. Lose SOC -1.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table.
events.3: You are deployed to suppress a planetary uprising. Roll END 8+ or STR 8+. If you fail, roll on the Injury table. If you succeed, gain Athletics 1 or Gun Combat 1.
events.4: An extended period of ceremonial duties hones your court manner. Gain Admin 1 or Carouse 1.
events.5: You intervene to protect a noble from an assassination attempt. Gain Melee (blade) 1 and a Contact among the Imperial nobility.
events.6: Deployed alongside Imperial forces in a border conflict. Gain Gun Combat 1 or Tactics (military) 1.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: Palace duty brings you into the orbit of the Imperial Court. Gain Diplomat 1 or Carouse 1, and gain D3 Contacts among the nobility.
events.9: Sent on a classified mission that cannot be discussed. Gain Stealth 1 or Recon 1.
events.10: Decorated for a term of distinguished service. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll.
events.11: A heroic act preserves Imperial prestige at a critical moment. Gain SOC +1 and an immediate promotion.
events.12: The Emperor personally recognises your service in a formal ceremony. Gain SOC +1 and two extra Benefit rolls.
